items.title: Chubby Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 14, 1998

ctx.x: Yeah. Because all these guys were in that photo. And that wasn’t called “Great Day in Harlem.” And a lady by the name of Jean Bach put this whole thing together, a lovely lady, too, and whoever was available — I mean Woody was not there because he was out of town, Lionel wasn’t there, Duke wasn’t there. But if you see that picture, I have a little picture of that with me—
